svg.text: 2. Frame, channel, temple housings, lids, ear pieces: SLS PA12 or resin, 1.5 mm walls.

4. Temples flex ~5 deg outward when worn; model shows them parallel.
5. Source of truth: cad/products/cam.py (regenerate with python -m cad.generate).
